metrics.providerTitle: Urban population (% of total population)
metrics.definition: Urban population refers to people living in urban areas as defined by national statistical offices. The data are collected and smoothed by United Nations Population Division.
metrics.provider: World Urbanization Prospects, United Nations (UN), uri: https://population.un.org/wup/, note: United Nations Population Division's World Urbanization Prospects, National definitions, publisher: UN Population Division

title.el: Φιλοξενούμενοι πρόσφυγες υπό την εντολή της UNHCR

metrics.definitionEl: Πρόσφυγες υπό την εντολή της UNHCR ανά χώρα ασύλου. Είναι πληθυσμιακό απόθεμα, όχι ετήσιες αφίξεις ή το σύνολο μεταναστών.
metrics.providerTitle: Refugees under the mandate of the UNHCR by country or territory of asylum
metrics.definition: Refugees under the mandate of the Office of the United Nations High Commissioner for Refugees (UNHCR) include individuals recognized under the 1951 Convention relating to the Status of Refugees, its 1967 Protocol, the 1969 Organization of African Unity (OAU) Convention Governing the Specific Aspects of Refugee Problems in Africa, the refugee definition contained in the 1984 Cartagena Declaration on Refugees as incorporated into national laws, those recognized in accordance with the UNHCR Statute, individuals granted complementary forms of protection, and those enjoying temporary protection. The refugee population also includes people in a refugee-like situation, which is a category that is descriptive in nature and includes groups of people who are outside their country or territory of origin and who face protection risks similar to those of refugees, but for whom refugee status has, for practical or other reasons, not been ascertained. Refugees under the mandate of the United Nations Relief and Works Agency for Palestine Refugees in the Near East (UNRWA), Palestine Refugees, are not typically included in the statistics on refugees (and people in a refugee-like situation) under the mandate of the UNHCR.
metrics.provider: Refugee Population Statistics Database, UN High Commissioner for Refugees (UNHCR), uri: https://www.unhcr.org/refugee-statistics/download

metrics.definitionEl: Συνδρομές σταθερής τηλεφωνίας ανά 100 κατοίκους. Μετρά συνδρομές, όχι μοναδικούς χρήστες.
metrics.providerTitle: Fixed telephone subscriptions (per 100 people)
metrics.definition: Fixed telephone subscriptions refers to the sum of active number of analogue fixed telephone lines, voice-over-IP (VoIP) subscriptions, fixed wireless local loop (WLL) subscriptions, ISDN voice-channel equivalents and fixed public payphones.
metrics.provider: World Telecommunication/ICT Indicators Database, International Telecommunication Union (ITU)

metrics.definitionEl: Αυτόματες ταμειολογιστικές μηχανές ανά 100.000 ενήλικους κατοίκους. Δεν είναι συνολικός αριθμός ΑΤΜ.
metrics.providerTitle: Automated teller machines (ATMs) (per 100,000 adults)
metrics.definition: Automated teller machines (ATMs) are electromechanical devices which enable customers of financial institutions to perform financial transactions such as cash withdrawals, balance inquiries, deposits, transfer of funds, and obtaining account information, using an electronic card.
metrics.provider: Financial Access Survey, International Monetary Fund (IMF), uri: https://data.imf.org/?sk=E5DCAB7E-A5CA-4892-A6EA-598B5463A34C

metrics.definitionEl: Διεθνείς μετανάστες που διαμένουν στη χώρα, κυρίως βάσει χώρας γέννησης ή υπηκοότητας όπου απαιτείται. Είναι απόθεμα σε έτη αναφοράς, όχι ετήσιες μεταναστευτικές ροές· τα ενδιάμεσα κενά παραμένουν.
metrics.providerTitle: International migrant stock, total
metrics.definition: International migrant stock, total is the number of people at mid-year born in a country other than that in which they live. It also includes refugees.
metrics.provider: International Migrant Stock, United Nations (UN), publisher: UN Population Division

metrics.definitionEl: Έσοδα χωρίς επιχορηγήσεις ως ποσοστό του ΑΕΠ, βάσει της σειράς δημοσιονομικών στατιστικών της Παγκόσμιας Τράπεζας. Η θεσμική κάλυψη του παρόχου δεν ταυτίζεται κατ’ ανάγκη με τη γενική κυβέρνηση της Eurostat.
metrics.providerTitle: Revenue, excluding grants (% of GDP)
metrics.definition: Revenue is an increase in net worth resulting from a transaction. Grants are excluded from this figure. This indicator is expressed as a percentage of Gross Domestic Product (GDP) which is the total income earned through the production of goods and services in an economic territory during an accounting period.
metrics.provider: Government Finance Statistics Yearbook and data files, International Monetary Fund (IMF)

title.en: Development aid to least developed countries
title.el: Αναπτυξιακή βοήθεια προς λιγότερο ανεπτυγμένες χώρες

metrics.definitionEl: Καθαρή επίσημη αναπτυξιακή βοήθεια που παρέχεται στις λιγότερο ανεπτυγμένες χώρες, σε τρέχοντα δολάρια ΗΠΑ. Δεν είναι βοήθεια που λαμβάνει η χώρα.
metrics.providerTitle: Net ODA provided, to the least developed countries (current US$)
metrics.definition: Net Official development assistance (ODA) comprises grants or loans to developing countries and territories on the OECD/DAC list of aid recipients that are undertaken by the official sector with promotion of economic development and welfare as the main objective and at concessional financial terms. The list of least developed countries (LDCs) has been agreed by the General Assembly, on the recommendation of the Committee for Development Policy, Economic and Social Council.

metrics.definitionEl: Ερευνητές έρευνας και ανάπτυξης σε ισοδύναμα πλήρους απασχόλησης ανά εκατομμύριο κατοίκους. Δεν είναι απλή καταμέτρηση προσώπων.
metrics.providerTitle: Researchers in R&D (per million people)
metrics.definition: The number of researchers engaged in Research &Development (R&D), expressed as per million. Researchers are professionals who conduct research and improve or develop concepts, theories, models techniques instrumentation, software of operational methods. R&D covers basic research, applied research, and experimental development.
metrics.provider: Stat Bulk Data Download Service, UN Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization (UNESCO), uri: https://databrowser.uis.unesco.org/resources/bulk, publisher: UNESCO Institute for Statistics (UIS), date accessed: 2025-03-26, date published: 2025-02

metrics.unit: MJ per constant 2021 PPP $ of GDP
metrics.definitionEl: Πρωτογενής ενέργεια ανά μονάδα ΑΕΠ σε σταθερά δολάρια 2021 αγοραστικής δύναμης. Επηρεάζεται από τη δομή της οικονομίας, όχι μόνο από την ενεργειακή απόδοση.
metrics.providerTitle: Energy intensity level of primary energy (MJ/$2021 PPP GDP)
metrics.definition: Energy intensity level of primary energy is the ratio between energy supply and gross domestic product measured at purchasing power parity. Energy intensity is an indication of how much energy is used to produce one unit of economic output. Lower ratio indicates that less energy is used to produce one unit of output.

metrics.definitionEl: Συνολική καθαρή επίσημη αναπτυξιακή βοήθεια που παρέχει η χώρα, σε τρέχοντα δολάρια ΗΠΑ. Πρόκειται για καθαρές ροές.
metrics.providerTitle: Net ODA provided, total (current US$)
metrics.definition: Net Official development assistance (ODA) comprises grants or loans to developing countries and territories on the OECD/DAC list of aid recipients that are undertaken by the official sector with promotion of economic development and welfare as the main objective and at concessional financial terms.

metrics.definitionEl: Συνολικά αποθεματικά εκφρασμένα σε μήνες εισαγωγών αγαθών και υπηρεσιών. Η συμμετοχή σε νομισματική ένωση έχει σημασία για την ερμηνεία.
metrics.providerTitle: Total reserves in months of imports
metrics.definition: Reserve assets are external assets, including monetary gold, that are readily available to and controlled by monetary authorities for meeting balance of payments financing needs, for intervention in exchange markets to affect the currency exchange rate, and for other related purposes (such as maintaining confidence in the currency and the economy, and serving as a basis for foreign borrowing). Reserve assets must be denominated and settled in foreign currency. This item is expressed in terms of the number of months of imports of goods and services they could pay for [X/(Imports/12)].
metrics.provider: International Financial Statistics database, International Monetary Fund (IMF)

metrics.definitionEl: Ακαθάριστος σχηματισμός παγίου κεφαλαίου ως ποσοστό του ΑΕΠ. Δεν περιλαμβάνει μεταβολές αποθεμάτων.
metrics.providerTitle: Gross fixed capital formation (% of GDP)
metrics.definition: Gross fixed capital formation includes acquisitions less disposals of fixed assets during the accounting period, including certain specified expenditures on services that add to the value of non-produced assets. This indicator is expressed as a percentage of Gross Domestic Product (GDP) which is the total income earned through the production of goods and services in an economic territory during an accounting period.

metrics.definitionEl: Ακαθάριστη εθνική αποταμίευση ως ποσοστό του ΑΕΠ· δεν αφορά μόνο τις αποταμιεύσεις νοικοκυριών.
metrics.providerTitle: Gross savings (% of GDP)
metrics.definition:
Savings is an amount that represents the part of disposable income (adjusted for the








change in pension entitlements) that is not spent on final consumption. Gross savings are calculated as gross national income less total consumption, plus net transfers. This indicator is expressed as a percentage of Gross Domestic Product (GDP) which is the total income earned through the production of goods and services in an economic territory during an accounting period.

metrics.definitionEl: Προστιθέμενη αξία του τομέα μεταποίησης ως ποσοστό του ΑΕΠ, με τον ορισμό του παρόχου.
metrics.providerTitle: Manufacturing, value added (% of GDP)
metrics.definition: Manufacturing includes industries classified in ISIC (Rev. 3) major division C and is defined as the physical or chemical transformation of materials or components into new products. Value added is the contribution to the economy by a producer or an industry or an institutional sector, which is estimated by the total value of output produced and deducting the total value of intermediate consumption of goods and services used to produce that output. This indicator is expressed as a percentage of Gross Domestic Product (GDP) which is the total income earned through the production of goods and services in an economic territory during an accounting period.

metrics.definitionEl: Ισοζύγιο τρεχουσών συναλλαγών ως ποσοστό του ΑΕΠ. Περιλαμβάνει αγαθά, υπηρεσίες και εισοδηματικές ροές· δεν είναι δημοσιονομικό ισοζύγιο.
metrics.providerTitle: Current account balance (% of GDP)
metrics.definition: Balance of current transactions (transactions in goods and services, earned income and transfer income) between residents and non-residents. The term current account balance is used in the external accounts and is expressed from the perspective of resident units. The term current external balance is used in the national accounts and is expressed from the perspective of the non-resident units, and therefore with the opposite sign. This indicator is expressed as a percentage of Gross Domestic Product (GDP) which is the total income earned through the production of goods and services in an economic territory during an accounting period.

metrics.definitionEl: Απασχολούμενοι ως ποσοστό του πληθυσμού ηλικίας 15+, βάσει μοντελοποιημένων εκτιμήσεων ILO. Δεν είναι ποσοστό επί του εργατικού δυναμικού.
metrics.providerTitle: Employment to population ratio, 15+, total (%) (modeled ILO estimate)
metrics.definition: Employment to population ratio is the proportion of a country's population that is employed.
metrics.provider: ILO Modelled Estimates database (ILOEST), International Labour Organization (ILO), uri: https://ilostat.ilo.org/data/bulk/, publisher: ILOSTAT, type: external database, date accessed: January 17, 2026

metrics.definitionEl: Αυτοαπασχολούμενοι ως ποσοστό της συνολικής απασχόλησης, βάσει μοντελοποιημένων εκτιμήσεων ILO. Περιλαμβάνονται οι κατηγορίες του ορισμού του παρόχου.
metrics.providerTitle: Self-employed, total (% of total employment) (modeled ILO estimate)
metrics.definition: Self-employed workers are those workers who, working on their own account or with one or a few partners or in cooperative, hold the type of jobs defined as a "self-employment jobs." i.e. jobs where the remuneration is directly dependent upon the profits derived from the goods and services produced. Self-employed workers include sub-categories of employers, own-account workers and members of producers' cooperatives and contributing family workers.
metrics.provider: ILO Modelled Estimates database (ILOEST), International Labour Organization (ILO), uri: https://ilostat.ilo.org/data/bulk/, publisher: ILOSTAT, type: external database, date accessed: January 17, 2026

title.en: Young people outside work, education or training
title.el: Νέοι εκτός εργασίας, εκπαίδευσης ή κατάρτισης

metrics.definitionEl: Νέοι ηλικίας 15–24 που δεν εργάζονται ούτε συμμετέχουν σε εκπαίδευση ή κατάρτιση, ως ποσοστό όλων των νέων της ηλικιακής ομάδας.
metrics.providerTitle: Share of youth not in education, employment or training, total (% of youth population)
metrics.definition: The share of youth not in education, employment or training (also known as “the NEET rate”) conveys the number of young persons not in education, employment or training as a percentage of the total youth population. Youth not in education are those who were neither enrolled in school nor in a formal training program (e.g. vocational training). For the purposes of this indicator, youth is defined as all persons between the ages of 15 and 24 (inclusive).
metrics.provider: Labour Force Statistics database (LFS), International Labour Organization (ILO), uri: https://ilostat.ilo.org/data/bulk/, publisher: ILOSTAT, type: external database, date accessed: June 22, 2026

metrics.definitionEl: Πιθανότητα θανάτου πριν από τα πέμπτα γενέθλια ανά 1.000 γεννήσεις ζώντων, βάσει εκτιμήσεων του παρόχου.
metrics.providerTitle: Mortality rate, under-5 (per 1,000 live births)
metrics.definition: Under-five mortality rate is the probability per 1,000 that a newborn baby will die before reaching age five, if subject to age-specific mortality rates of the specified year.

metrics.definitionEl: Άμεσες πληρωμές νοικοκυριών ως ποσοστό της τρέχουσας δαπάνης υγείας. Δεν είναι ποσοστό του εισοδήματος νοικοκυριών.
metrics.providerTitle: Out-of-pocket expenditure (% of current health expenditure)
metrics.definition: Share of out-of-pocket payments of total current health expenditures.  Out-of-pocket payments are spending on health directly out-of-pocket by households.
metrics.provider: Global Health Expenditure Database, updated December 12th, 2025, World Health Organization (WHO), uri: http://apps.who.int/nha/database

metrics.definitionEl: Γενικοί και ειδικοί ιατροί ανά 1.000 κατοίκους. Η εθνική κάλυψη προσωπικού μπορεί να διαφέρει· δεν μετρά άμεσα πρόσβαση ή ποιότητα φροντίδας.
metrics.providerTitle: Physicians (per 1,000 people)
metrics.definition: Physicians include generalist and specialist medical practitioners.

title.en: Premature mortality from four major NCDs
title.el: Πρόωρη θνησιμότητα από τέσσερις κύριες μη μεταδοτικές νόσους

metrics.definitionEl: Πιθανότητα θανάτου μεταξύ 30 και 70 ετών από καρδιαγγειακά νοσήματα, καρκίνο, διαβήτη ή χρόνια αναπνευστικά νοσήματα, υπό τους τρέχοντες δείκτες θνησιμότητας. Δεν είναι μερίδιο όλων των θανάτων.
metrics.providerTitle: Mortality from CVD, cancer, diabetes or CRD between exact ages 30 and 70 (%)
metrics.definition: Mortality from CVD, cancer, diabetes or CRD is the percent of 30-year-old-people who would die before their 70th birthday from any of cardiovascular disease, cancer, diabetes,  or chronic respiratory disease, assuming that s/he would experience current mortality rates at every age and s/he would not die from any other cause of death (e.g., injuries or HIV/AIDS).
metrics.provider: World Health Organization, Global Health Observatory Data Repository (http://apps.who.int/ghodata/)., World Health Organization (WHO), uri: https://www.who.int/data/gho

title.el: Εγγραφές στην προσχολική εκπαίδευση, ακαθάριστο ποσοστό

metrics.definitionEl: Συνολικές εγγραφές στην προσχολική εκπαίδευση, ανεξαρτήτως ηλικίας, προς τον πληθυσμό της επίσημης ηλικιακής ομάδας. Μπορεί να υπερβαίνει το 100%. Η τελευταία ελληνική παρατήρηση έχει σημαντική υστέρηση.
metrics.providerTitle: School enrollment, preprimary (% gross)
metrics.definition: Gross enrollment ratio is the ratio of total enrollment, regardless of age, to the population of the age group that officially corresponds to the level of education shown. Preprimary education refers to programs at the initial stage of organized instruction, designed primarily to introduce very young children to a school-type environment and to provide a bridge between home and school.
metrics.provider: Stat Bulk Data Download Service, UN Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization (UNESCO), uri: https://uis.unesco.org/bdds, publisher: UNESCO Institute for Statistics (UIS)

metrics.definitionEl: Μετανάστες που εισέρχονται μείον όσους εξέρχονται κατά την περίοδο αναφοράς, συμπεριλαμβανομένων πολιτών και μη πολιτών. Είναι καθαρή ροή, όχι πληθυσμιακό απόθεμα.
metrics.providerTitle: Net migration
metrics.definition: Net migration is the net total of migrants during the period, that is, the number of immigrants minus the number of emigrants, including both citizens and noncitizens.
metrics.provider: World Population Prospects, United Nations (UN), publisher: UN Population Division

metrics.definitionEl: Ετήσιος ρυθμός μεταβολής αστικού πληθυσμού. Οι εθνικοί ορισμοί αστικών περιοχών διαφέρουν.
metrics.providerTitle: Urban population growth (annual %)
metrics.definition: Annual urban population growth rate for year t is the exponential rate of growth of midyear urban population from year t-1 to t, expressed as a percentage. Urban population refers to people living in urban areas as defined by national statistical offices. It is calculated using World Bank total population estimates and urban ratios from the United Nations World Urbanization Prospects.
metrics.provider:
World Urbanization Prospects, United Nations (UN), uri: https://population.un.org/wup/, note: World Bank staff estimates based on the United Nations Population Division's World Urbanization Prospects, National definitions, publisher: UN Population Division;
Staff estimates, World Bank (WB), note: World Bank staff estimates based on the United Nations Population Division's World Urbanization Prospects, National definitions

metrics.definitionEl: Απώλειες στη μεταφορά και διανομή ως ποσοστό της παραγωγής ηλεκτρικής ενέργειας, σύμφωνα με τον ορισμό του παρόχου.
metrics.providerTitle: Electric power transmission and distribution losses (% of output)
metrics.definition: Electric power transmission and distribution losses include losses in transmission between sources of supply and points of distribution and in the distribution to consumers, including pilferage. The losses are expressed as a share of the total output.
metrics.provider: IEA Energy Statistics Data Browser, International Energy Agency (IEA), uri: https://www.iea.org/data-and-statistics/data-tools/energy-statistics-data-browser, publisher: International Energy Agency (IEA), date accessed: 2025-03-25

metrics.definitionEl: Απολήψεις γλυκού νερού ως ποσοστό διαθέσιμων ανανεώσιμων πόρων, αφού ληφθούν υπόψη οι περιβαλλοντικές απαιτήσεις ροής. Δεν είναι οικιακή κατανάλωση νερού.
metrics.providerTitle: Level of water stress: freshwater withdrawal as a proportion of available freshwater resources
metrics.definition: The level of water stress: freshwater withdrawal as a proportion of available freshwater resources is the ratio between total freshwater withdrawn by all major sectors and total renewable freshwater resources, after taking into account environmental water requirements. Main sectors, as defined by ISIC standards, include agriculture; forestry and fishing; manufacturing; electricity industry; and services. This indicator is also known as water withdrawal intensity.
metrics.provider: AQUASTAT - FAO's Global Information System on Water and Agriculture, Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO), uri: https://data.apps.fao.org/aquastat/, publisher: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO), date accessed: 20240529

metrics.definitionEl: Όγκος σιδηροδρομικού εμπορευματικού έργου σε εκατομμύρια τονοχιλιόμετρα. Συνδυάζει βάρος και απόσταση, όχι μόνο τόνους φορτίου.
metrics.providerTitle: Railways, goods transported (million ton-km)
metrics.definition: Goods transported by railway are the volume of goods transported by railway, measured in metric tons times kilometers traveled.
metrics.provider:
Railisa Database (UIC), International Union of Railways (UIC), uri: https://uic-stats.uic.org/select/;
OECD Statistics, Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development (OECD)

metrics.definitionEl: Διακίνηση εμπορευματοκιβωτίων σε ισοδύναμες μονάδες είκοσι ποδών (TEU), βάσει της κάλυψης λιμένων του παρόχου. Δεν είναι βάρος φορτίου.
metrics.providerTitle: Container port traffic (TEU: 20 foot equivalent units)
metrics.definition: Port container traffic measures the flow of containers from land to sea transport modes, and vice versa, in twenty-foot equivalent units (TEUs), a standard-size container. Data refer to coastal shipping as well as international journeys. Transshipment traffic is counted as two lifts at the intermediate port (once to off-load and again as an outbound lift) and includes empty units.
metrics.provider: UN Conference on Trade and Development (UNCTAD), uri: http://unctad.org/en/Pages/statistics.aspx

metrics.definitionEl: Παγκόσμιες αναχωρήσεις αερομεταφορέων εγγεγραμμένων στη χώρα. Δεν είναι όλες οι αναχωρήσεις από τα αεροδρόμια της χώρας.
metrics.providerTitle: Air transport, registered carrier departures worldwide
metrics.definition: Registered carrier departures worldwide are domestic takeoffs and takeoffs abroad of air carriers registered in the country.
metrics.provider:
Civil Aviation Statistics of the World, International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO), uri: https://data.icao.int/newdataplus/#:~:text=ICAO%20data%20is%20comprised%20of,information%20about%20commercial%20air%20carriers;
ICAO Staff estimates, International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO), uri: https://data.icao.int/newdataplus/#:~:text=ICAO%20data%20is%20comprised%20of,information%20about%20commercial%20air%20carriers

metrics.definitionEl: Εγχώρια χρηματοδότηση του ιδιωτικού τομέα από χρηματοπιστωτικές επιχειρήσεις ως ποσοστό του ΑΕΠ. Δεν είναι μόνο νέα δάνεια ενός έτους.
metrics.providerTitle: Domestic credit to private sector (% of GDP)
metrics.definition: Domestic credit to private sector refers to financial resources provided to the private sector by financial corporations, such as through loans, purchases of nonequity securities, and trade credits and other accounts receivable, that establish a claim for repayment. For some countries these claims include credit to public enterprises. The financial corporations include monetary authorities and deposit money banks, as well as other financial corporations where data are available (including corporations that do not accept transferable deposits but do incur such liabilities as time and savings deposits). Examples of other financial corporations are finance and leasing companies, money lenders, insurance corporations, pension funds, and foreign exchange companies. This indicator is expressed as a percentage of Gross Domestic Product (GDP) which is the total income earned through the production of goods and services in an economic territory during an accounting period.

metrics.definitionEl: Νέες εγγραφές εταιρειών περιορισμένης ευθύνης ανά 1.000 άτομα ηλικίας 15–64. Δεν περιλαμβάνει κάθε μορφή επιχειρηματικής δραστηριότητας.
metrics.providerTitle: New business density (new registrations per 1,000 people ages 15-64)
metrics.definition: The number of newly registered firms with limited liability per 1,000 working-age people (ages 15-64) per calendar year.
metrics.provider: Entrepreneurship Database, World Bank (WB), uri: https://www.worldbank.org/en/programs/entrepreneurship

metrics.definitionEl: Αγαθά τεχνολογιών πληροφορικής και επικοινωνιών ως ποσοστό συνολικών εξαγωγών αγαθών. Δεν περιλαμβάνει υπηρεσίες ΤΠΕ.
metrics.providerTitle: ICT goods exports (% of total goods exports)
metrics.definition: Information and communication technology goods exports include computers and peripheral equipment, communication equipment, consumer electronic equipment, electronic components, and other information and technology goods (miscellaneous).
metrics.provider: UNCTADstat database, UN Conference on Trade and Development (UNCTAD), uri: http://unctadstat.unctad.org/ReportFolders/reportFolders.aspx

metrics.definitionEl: Φυσικά υποκαταστήματα εμπορικών τραπεζών ανά 100.000 ενήλικους κατοίκους. Δεν είναι μέτρο ψηφιακής πρόσβασης ή ποιότητας τραπεζικών υπηρεσιών.
metrics.providerTitle: Commercial bank branches (per 100,000 adults)
metrics.definition: Commercial bank branches are retail locations of resident commercial banks and other resident banks that function as commercial banks that provide financial services to customers and are physically separated from the main office but not organized as legally separated subsidiaries.
metrics.provider: Financial Access Survey, International Monetary Fund (IMF), uri: https://data.imf.org/en/datasets/IMF.STA:FAS

metrics.definition: Police officers, both sexes, per 1,000 residents. Eurostat reports officers per 100,000 residents; Datacritus divides each non-missing observation by 100. This measures staffing density, not policing effectiveness. Source quality flags are retained.
metrics.definitionEl: Αστυνομικοί και των δύο φύλων ανά 1.000 κατοίκους. Η Eurostat δίνει τιμές ανά 100.000 κατοίκους· κάθε διαθέσιμη τιμή διαιρείται με 100. Μετρά πυκνότητα προσωπικού, όχι αποτελεσματικότητα αστυνόμευσης. Διατηρούνται οι σημάνσεις ποιότητας.
metrics.providerTitle: Personnel in the criminal justice system by sex
metrics.provider: Eurostat / national statistical authorities

metrics.definition: Mean age of women at childbirth, considering all births, using age-specific fertility rates. Not the mean age at first birth.
metrics.definitionEl: Μέση ηλικία γυναικών στον τοκετό για όλες τις γεννήσεις, βάσει των ειδικών κατά ηλικία δεικτών γονιμότητας. Δεν είναι η μέση ηλικία στην πρώτη γέννηση.
metrics.providerTitle: Fertility indicators
metrics.provider: Eurostat / national statistical authorities

metrics.definition: Total expenditure of general government (sector S13) as a percentage of GDP, under ESA 2010. Includes central, regional and local government and social security funds; distinct from central-government expense.
metrics.definitionEl: Συνολικές δαπάνες γενικής κυβέρνησης (τομέας S13) ως ποσοστό του ΑΕΠ, βάσει ESA 2010. Περιλαμβάνει κεντρική, περιφερειακή και τοπική διοίκηση και οργανισμούς κοινωνικής ασφάλισης· διαφέρει από τα έξοδα μόνο της κεντρικής κυβέρνησης.
metrics.providerTitle: Government revenue, expenditure and main aggregates
metrics.provider: Eurostat / national statistical authorities

metrics.definition: Consolidated gross debt of general government (S13), at nominal value, as a percentage of GDP. Maastricht definition; distinct from central government debt.
metrics.providerTitle: Government deficit/surplus, debt and associated data
metrics.provider: Eurostat / national statistical authorities

metrics.definition: General government net lending (+) or net borrowing (−), as a percentage of GDP, under ESA 2010 / the Excessive Deficit Procedure.
metrics.providerTitle: Government deficit/surplus, debt and associated data
metrics.provider: Eurostat / national statistical authorities

metrics.definition: Share of people living in households where total housing costs, net of housing allowances, exceed 40% of total disposable household income, net of housing allowances. EU-SILC; all ages, both sexes, total poverty status.
metrics.providerTitle: Housing cost overburden rate by age, sex and poverty status
metrics.provider: Eurostat / national statistical authorities

metrics.definition: Employment in cultural economic activities and cultural occupations as a percentage of total employment. Both sexes; EU Labour Force Survey. Eurostat cultural employment definition applies; survey breaks and reliability flags are retained.
metrics.providerTitle: Cultural employment by sex
metrics.provider: Eurostat / national statistical authorities

metrics.definition: Municipal waste recycled as a percentage of municipal waste generated. Includes material recycling, composting and anaerobic digestion; not all industrial waste.
metrics.definitionEl: Ανακυκλωμένα αστικά απόβλητα ως ποσοστό των παραγόμενων αστικών αποβλήτων. Περιλαμβάνει ανακύκλωση υλικών, κομποστοποίηση και αναερόβια χώνευση.
metrics.providerTitle: Recycling rate of municipal waste
metrics.provider: Eurostat / national statistical authorities

metrics.definition: Arrivals of non-residents at hotels and similar accommodation (NACE I551). Counts check-ins, not unique visitors or all border arrivals.
metrics.definitionEl: Αφίξεις μη κατοίκων σε ξενοδοχεία και παρόμοια καταλύματα (NACE I551). Μετρά αφίξεις σε καταλύματα, όχι μοναδικά πρόσωπα ή όλες τις συνοριακές αφίξεις.
metrics.providerTitle: Arrivals at tourist accommodation establishments
metrics.provider: Eurostat / national statistical authorities

metrics.definition: Arrivals of residents at hotels and similar accommodation (NACE I551). A person may be counted on more than one trip.
metrics.definitionEl: Αφίξεις κατοίκων σε ξενοδοχεία και παρόμοια καταλύματα (NACE I551). Το ίδιο άτομο μπορεί να καταμετρηθεί σε περισσότερα ταξίδια.
metrics.providerTitle: Arrivals at tourist accommodation establishments
metrics.provider: Eurostat / national statistical authorities

title.en: Resident overnight tourist trips, domestic and abroad

metrics.definition: Overnight tourism trips by residents aged 15 or over, all destinations and purposes, lasting at least one night. Not inbound arrivals or same-day visits.
metrics.definitionEl: Τουριστικά ταξίδια κατοίκων ηλικίας 15+ με τουλάχιστον μία διανυκτέρευση, για όλους τους προορισμούς και σκοπούς. Δεν είναι εισερχόμενες αφίξεις ή αυθημερόν επισκέψεις.
metrics.providerTitle: Trips by duration, purpose and main destination
metrics.provider: Eurostat / national statistical authorities

metrics.definition: Average self-reported overall life satisfaction among people aged 16 or over, from 0 (not at all satisfied) to 10 (fully satisfied). Survey observations are not annual throughout the series.
metrics.definitionEl: Μέση αυτοαναφερόμενη ικανοποίηση από τη ζωή για ηλικίες 16+, από 0 (καθόλου) έως 10 (πλήρως). Οι διαθέσιμες έρευνες δεν καλύπτουν κάθε έτος.
metrics.providerTitle: Overall life satisfaction by sex, age and educational attainment
metrics.provider: Eurostat / national statistical authorities

metrics.definition: One-person households as a percentage of private households. Household share, not the share of people living alone.
metrics.definitionEl: Μονοπρόσωπα νοικοκυριά ως ποσοστό των ιδιωτικών νοικοκυριών. Δεν είναι ποσοστό ατόμων που ζουν μόνα.
metrics.providerTitle: Distribution of households by household type from 2003 onwards
metrics.provider: Eurostat / national statistical authorities

metrics.definition: CO2 emissions from domestic-inventory transport (CRF 1A3), excluding international aviation and shipping bunkers. Territorial inventory, not a consumption footprint.
metrics.definitionEl: Εκπομπές CO₂ από μεταφορές στην εθνική απογραφή (CRF 1A3), χωρίς διεθνή αεροπορικά και ναυτιλιακά καύσιμα. Δεν είναι αποτύπωμα κατανάλωσης.
metrics.providerTitle: Greenhouse gas emissions by source sector
metrics.provider: Eurostat / national statistical authorities

metrics.definition: CO2 emissions from domestic civil aviation (CRF 1A3A). Excludes international aviation bunkers; not the full climate impact of flying.
metrics.definitionEl: Εκπομπές CO₂ από εγχώρια πολιτική αεροπορία (CRF 1A3A). Δεν περιλαμβάνει διεθνή αεροπορία ή άλλες κλιματικές επιδράσεις των πτήσεων.
metrics.providerTitle: Greenhouse gas emissions by source sector
metrics.provider: Eurostat / national statistical authorities

metrics.definition: People below 60% of national median equivalised disposable income after social transfers. Relative poverty, not an absolute living-standard threshold. EU-SILC income usually refers to the preceding year; retain survey-year labels and breaks.
metrics.definitionEl: Πληθυσμός κάτω από το 60% του εθνικού διάμεσου ισοδύναμου διαθέσιμου εισοδήματος μετά τις κοινωνικές μεταβιβάσεις. Σχετική φτώχεια, όχι απόλυτο όριο διαβίωσης. Το εισόδημα συνήθως αφορά το προηγούμενο έτος· διατηρούνται τα έτη έρευνας και οι τομές.
metrics.providerTitle: At-risk-of-poverty rate by poverty threshold, age and sex - EU-SILC and ECHP surveys
metrics.provider: Eurostat / national statistical authorities

title.en: At risk of poverty or social exclusion

metrics.definition: EU 2030 AROPE definition: at least one of income poverty, severe material and social deprivation, or very low household work intensity. Components overlap; do not add their rates. Not spliced with the older AROPE definition.
metrics.definitionEl: Ορισμός AROPE ΕΕ 2030: τουλάχιστον μία από εισοδηματική φτώχεια, σοβαρή υλική και κοινωνική στέρηση ή πολύ χαμηλή ένταση εργασίας. Τα επιμέρους ποσοστά επικαλύπτονται και δεν αθροίζονται. Δεν συνδέεται με τον παλαιότερο ορισμό.
metrics.providerTitle: Persons at risk of poverty or social exclusion by age and sex
metrics.provider: Eurostat / national statistical authorities

metrics.definition: People unable to afford at least seven of thirteen material and social items. This is the revised material and social deprivation measure, not the older nine-item measure.
metrics.definitionEl: Άτομα που αδυνατούν οικονομικά να καλύψουν τουλάχιστον επτά από δεκατρία υλικά και κοινωνικά αγαθά ή δραστηριότητες. Δεν είναι ο παλαιότερος δείκτης εννέα στοιχείων.
metrics.providerTitle: Severe material and social deprivation rate by age and sex
metrics.provider: Eurostat / national statistical authorities

metrics.definition: People in overcrowded dwellings under the Eurostat room requirement based on household size, ages and composition. All ages, both sexes, all income groups.
metrics.definitionEl: Πληθυσμός σε κατοικίες με ανεπαρκή αριθμό δωματίων σύμφωνα με το μέγεθος, τις ηλικίες και τη σύνθεση του νοικοκυριού. Όλες οι ηλικίες, φύλα και εισοδηματικές ομάδες.
metrics.providerTitle: Overcrowding rate by age, sex and poverty status - total population
metrics.provider: Eurostat / national statistical authorities

title.en: Unable to keep home adequately warm

metrics.definition: People in households reporting inability to afford adequate home warmth. EU-SILC self-reported affordability measure, not measured indoor temperature.
metrics.definitionEl: Άτομα σε νοικοκυριά που δηλώνουν οικονομική αδυναμία επαρκούς θέρμανσης. Αυτοαναφερόμενος δείκτης EU-SILC, όχι μέτρηση θερμοκρασίας.
metrics.providerTitle: Inability to keep home adequately warm
metrics.provider: Eurostat / national statistical authorities

metrics.definition: Average number of people per private household. Excludes institutional households under the survey definition.
metrics.definitionEl: Μέσος αριθμός ατόμων ανά ιδιωτικό νοικοκυριό. Εξαιρούνται συλλογικά νοικοκυριά βάσει του ορισμού της έρευνας.
metrics.providerTitle: Average household size
metrics.provider: Eurostat / national statistical authorities

metrics.definition: Median annual equivalised disposable income in nominal euros, all ages and both sexes. Adjusted for household composition, not inflation or purchasing power. Income reference period is usually the previous calendar year.
metrics.definitionEl: Διάμεσο ετήσιο ισοδύναμο διαθέσιμο εισόδημα σε ονομαστικά ευρώ. Προσαρμόζεται στη σύνθεση νοικοκυριού, όχι στον πληθωρισμό ή στην αγοραστική δύναμη. Το εισόδημα συνήθως αφορά το προηγούμενο ημερολογιακό έτος.
metrics.providerTitle: Mean and median income by age and sex
metrics.provider: Eurostat / national statistical authorities

metrics.definition: People aged 18–24 with at most lower secondary education and no education or training in the preceding four weeks. EU Labour Force Survey; retain methodology breaks.
metrics.definitionEl: Άτομα 18–24 με εκπαίδευση έως κατώτερη δευτεροβάθμια που δεν συμμετείχαν σε εκπαίδευση ή κατάρτιση τις προηγούμενες τέσσερις εβδομάδες. Διατηρούνται οι μεθοδολογικές τομές της Έρευνας Εργατικού Δυναμικού.
metrics.providerTitle: Early leavers from education and training by sex
metrics.provider: Eurostat / national statistical authorities

metrics.definition: People aged 25–34 who have completed tertiary education, ISCED levels 5–8. Attainment, not current enrolment.
metrics.definitionEl: Άτομα 25–34 που έχουν ολοκληρώσει τριτοβάθμια εκπαίδευση, επίπεδα ISCED 5–8. Μετρά ολοκληρωμένες σπουδές, όχι τρέχουσες εγγραφές.
metrics.providerTitle: Persons aged 25-34 with tertiary educational attainment level
metrics.provider: Eurostat / national statistical authorities

metrics.definition: Nights spent by non-residents in hotels and similar accommodation, NACE I551. Counts nights, not unique visitors; excludes other accommodation types.
metrics.definitionEl: Διανυκτερεύσεις μη κατοίκων σε ξενοδοχεία και παρόμοια καταλύματα, NACE I551. Δεν είναι μοναδικοί επισκέπτες και εξαιρούνται άλλοι τύποι καταλυμάτων.
metrics.providerTitle: Nights spent at tourist accommodation establishments
metrics.provider: Eurostat / national statistical authorities

title.el: Ταξίδια κατοίκων στο εξωτερικό με διανυκτέρευση

metrics.definition: Trips abroad by residents aged 15+, all purposes, lasting at least one night. Trips rather than unique travellers or inbound tourism.
metrics.definitionEl: Ταξίδια στο εξωτερικό από κατοίκους ηλικίας 15+, για όλους τους σκοπούς, με τουλάχιστον μία διανυκτέρευση. Μετρά ταξίδια, όχι μοναδικούς ταξιδιώτες ή εισερχόμενο τουρισμό.
metrics.providerTitle: Trips by duration, purpose and main destination
metrics.provider: Eurostat / national statistical authorities

metrics.definition: Professional judges, both sexes, Eurostat justice personnel category OC2612A. Absolute staffing count, not a measure of judicial independence or court efficiency. National institutional definitions may differ.
metrics.definitionEl: Επαγγελματίες δικαστές και των δύο φύλων, κατηγορία OC2612A. Απόλυτος αριθμός προσωπικού, όχι μέτρο ανεξαρτησίας ή αποτελεσματικότητας. Οι εθνικοί θεσμικοί ορισμοί μπορεί να διαφέρουν.
metrics.providerTitle: Personnel in the criminal justice system by sex
metrics.provider: Eurostat / national statistical authorities

metrics.definition: People held in prison per 100,000 inhabitants, Eurostat PRIS_ACT_CAP. A population stock, not annual admissions, prison capacity or a crime rate. National scope differences and flags apply.
metrics.definitionEl: Κρατούμενοι ανά 100.000 κατοίκους, δείκτης PRIS_ACT_CAP. Πληθυσμιακό απόθεμα, όχι ετήσιες εισαγωγές, χωρητικότητα φυλακών ή δείκτης εγκληματικότητας. Ισχύουν εθνικές διαφορές κάλυψης.
metrics.providerTitle: Prison capacity and number of persons held
metrics.provider: Eurostat / national statistical authorities

title.el: Μέση ηλικία μητέρας στην πρώτη γέννηση

metrics.definition: Mean age of women at the birth of their first child, using age-specific first-birth fertility rates. Distinct from age at all childbirths.
metrics.definitionEl: Μέση ηλικία γυναικών στην πρώτη γέννηση, βάσει ειδικών κατά ηλικία δεικτών πρώτης γέννησης. Διαφέρει από τη μέση ηλικία για όλες τις γεννήσεις.
metrics.providerTitle: Fertility indicators
metrics.provider: Eurostat / national statistical authorities

metrics.definition: Total revenue of general government, sector S13, ESA 2010, as a percentage of GDP. Broader institutional scope than central-government revenue.
metrics.definitionEl: Συνολικά έσοδα γενικής κυβέρνησης, τομέας S13, ESA 2010, ως ποσοστό του ΑΕΠ. Ευρύτερη θεσμική κάλυψη από τα έσοδα μόνο της κεντρικής κυβέρνησης.
metrics.providerTitle: Government revenue, expenditure and main aggregates
metrics.provider: Eurostat / national statistical authorities

metrics.definition: Interest payable by general government, ESA 2010 D41PAY, as a percentage of GDP. Interest expense, not principal repayments or a bond yield.
metrics.definitionEl: Πληρωτέοι τόκοι γενικής κυβέρνησης, ESA 2010 D41PAY, ως ποσοστό του ΑΕΠ. Δεν είναι αποπληρωμές κεφαλαίου ή απόδοση ομολόγου.
metrics.providerTitle: Government revenue, expenditure and main aggregates
metrics.provider: Eurostat / national statistical authorities

metrics.definition: General government expenditure on social protection, COFOG GF10, as a percentage of GDP. Functional expenditure including pensions; not an outcome or poverty-reduction score.
metrics.definitionEl: Δαπάνες γενικής κυβέρνησης για κοινωνική προστασία, COFOG GF10, ως ποσοστό του ΑΕΠ. Περιλαμβάνει συντάξεις· δεν αποτελεί μέτρο αποτελέσματος ή μείωσης φτώχειας.
metrics.providerTitle: General government expenditure by function (COFOG)
metrics.provider: Eurostat / national statistical authorities

metrics.definition: General government expenditure, COFOG GF08, as a percentage of GDP. Includes recreation, sport and religion as well as culture; do not label as culture-only expenditure.
metrics.definitionEl: Δαπάνες γενικής κυβέρνησης, COFOG GF08, ως ποσοστό του ΑΕΠ. Περιλαμβάνει αναψυχή, αθλητισμό και θρησκεία· δεν αφορά αποκλειστικά πολιτισμό.
metrics.providerTitle: General government expenditure by function (COFOG)
metrics.provider: Eurostat / national statistical authorities

metrics.definition: General government expenditure on environmental protection, COFOG GF05, as a percentage of GDP. Functional spending, not all climate-related investment.
metrics.definitionEl: Δαπάνες γενικής κυβέρνησης για περιβαλλοντική προστασία, COFOG GF05, ως ποσοστό του ΑΕΠ. Δεν περιλαμβάνει αναγκαστικά όλες τις επενδύσεις για το κλίμα.
metrics.providerTitle: General government expenditure by function (COFOG)
metrics.provider: Eurostat / national statistical authorities

metrics.definition: General government expenditure on housing and community amenities, COFOG GF06, as a percentage of GDP. Not all housing benefits, which can fall under social protection.
metrics.definitionEl: Δαπάνες γενικής κυβέρνησης για στέγαση και υποδομές κοινής ωφέλειας, COFOG GF06, ως ποσοστό του ΑΕΠ. Δεν περιλαμβάνει όλα τα στεγαστικά επιδόματα, που μπορεί να κατατάσσονται στην κοινωνική προστασία.
metrics.providerTitle: General government expenditure by function (COFOG)
metrics.provider: Eurostat / national statistical authorities

metrics.definition: Renewable energy share in transport under the EU Renewable Energy Directive accounting rules. Multipliers and methodology changes mean this is not a simple physical fuel-volume share.
metrics.definitionEl: Μερίδιο ανανεώσιμης ενέργειας στις μεταφορές σύμφωνα με την ευρωπαϊκή οδηγία. Συντελεστές και μεθοδολογικές αλλαγές σημαίνουν ότι δεν είναι απλό φυσικό μερίδιο όγκου καυσίμων.
metrics.providerTitle: Main indicators - share of renewable energy
metrics.provider: Eurostat / national statistical authorities

title.el: Ανανεώσιμη ενέργεια στη θέρμανση και ψύξη

metrics.unit: % of heating and cooling energy consumption
metrics.definition: Renewable share of energy used for heating and cooling, Eurostat SHARES / Renewable Energy Directive methodology. Retain provider breaks.
metrics.definitionEl: Μερίδιο ανανεώσιμης ενέργειας στη θέρμανση και ψύξη, βάσει Eurostat SHARES και της ευρωπαϊκής οδηγίας. Διατηρούνται οι μεθοδολογικές τομές.
metrics.providerTitle: Main indicators - share of renewable energy
metrics.provider: Eurostat / national statistical authorities

metrics.definition: New registrations of battery-electric passenger cars, energy category ELC. Excludes plug-in hybrids. Registrations are not sales; this is an explicitly labelled alternative to the thesis sales request.
metrics.definitionEl: Νέες ταξινομήσεις αμιγώς ηλεκτρικών επιβατικών αυτοκινήτων, κατηγορία ELC. Εξαιρούνται τα επαναφορτιζόμενα υβριδικά. Οι ταξινομήσεις δεν ταυτίζονται με πωλήσεις· πρόκειται για ρητά διακριτό εναλλακτικό δείκτη.
metrics.providerTitle: New passenger cars by type of motor energy
metrics.provider: Eurostat / national statistical authorities

metrics.definition: Unemployed for 12 months or more as a percentage of the active population aged 15–74, both sexes. Denominator is the labour force, not all unemployed people.
metrics.definitionEl: Άνεργοι επί 12 μήνες ή περισσότερο ως ποσοστό του εργατικού δυναμικού 15–74, και των δύο φύλων. Παρονομαστής είναι το εργατικό δυναμικό, όχι το σύνολο των ανέργων.
metrics.providerTitle: Long-term unemployment by sex - annual data
metrics.provider: Eurostat / national statistical authorities

title.el: Μέσος ετήσιος μισθός προσαρμοσμένος σε πλήρη απασχόληση

metrics.definition: Average annual salary per employee adjusted to full-time work, national accounts and Labour Force Survey methodology. Nominal gross euros; not median pay, take-home income or inflation-adjusted purchasing power.
metrics.definitionEl: Μέσος ετήσιος μισθός ανά μισθωτό προσαρμοσμένος σε πλήρη απασχόληση, βάσει εθνικών λογαριασμών και Έρευνας Εργατικού Δυναμικού. Ονομαστικά μικτά ευρώ, όχι διάμεσος ή καθαρός μισθός ούτε πραγματική αγοραστική δύναμη.
metrics.providerTitle: Average full time adjusted salary per employee
metrics.provider: Eurostat / national statistical authorities
